_comment: E2E (manual, live): gdocs_insert_image_after_text path (i) URL-only. The agent reads an OPERATOR-PROVIDED Google Doc (shared as Editor with agents@startti.co), picks an existing text anchor, and inserts a public image right after it via insertInlineImage. Replace <YOUR_DOC_ID> with a real doc id. Auth: OAuth user-scoped, injected in-memory.

test_payload.prompt:
Work on Google Doc id <YOUR_DOC_ID>. HARD RULE: do NOT call gdocs_read_as_markdown (it uses Drive export, blocked for shared docs). Steps:
1. Call gdocs_read_outline on <YOUR_DOC_ID> (this uses the Docs API). Pick a SHORT exact text_preview substring from the first non-empty paragraph as your anchor (copy it verbatim).
2. Call gdocs_insert_image_after_text with doc_id=<YOUR_DOC_ID>, anchor=<that exact substring>, image_url='https://www.google.com/images/branding/googlelogo/2x/googlelogo_color_272x92dp.png'. Do not pass width_pt/height_pt (use native size).
3. Report the EXACT tool result of step 2 verbatim: the `changes` array, `revision_id_after`, and whether `lossy_conversions` is empty. If it errored, paste the error envelope.

config.system_message: You are a precise document editor. Use the gdocs tools. The anchor must be an EXACT verbatim substring of the document's current text. Report tool results verbatim.
